style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines and mannequins (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, police or military badges, readable text or numbers, people being shot, blood, wounds, faces resembling real people
